task: Write an async FastAPI handler get_dashboard() that pulls JSON from three internal service URLs, reads the local template file dashboard.html, and returns everything combined in one JSON response.

constraints.text: blocking HTTP clients (requests, urllib) stay out of async handlers
constraints.why: one requests.get inside a handler froze the whole event loop during the 2026-01 gateway brownout; every other request queued behind it

constraints.text: service calls go through httpx.AsyncClient with await
constraints.why: standardizing on one async client after the 2026-01 freeze made loop-blocking imports greppable in CI

constraints.text: file reads inside handlers hop off the loop via asyncio.to_thread or aiofiles
constraints.why: a 40 ms template read off NFS stalled the loop under load in the 2025-11 spike, tripling p99 latency across the service

checks.description: template read blocks the event loop
